1. You cannot cry out at every wound, turn on the light at every darkness, reach out at every longing, or run home at every moment of weakness. Can you?
2. Do not become an unfinished book of poems. Be the chapter that shakes the world.
3. Live like the brilliant flowers of summer: vivid, unyielding, and ablaze.
4. The only person you need to surpass is who you were yesterday.
5. I rise from the ruins, absolving your sins and mine.
